Makes a constraint break when it carries more than this force in a step. A broken constraint stops working for good (the bodies move freely), `GetPhysicsConstraintBroken` says so. The force is an estimate from the solver and is only good for breaking when the load is clearly larger or smaller than the value. 0 turns breaking off.
@param constraint The constraint.
@param force The force in newtons, 0 for a constraint that does not break.
@gap The original has no such command. This is an extension; programs that use it do not compile with the original Blitz3D.
